_readme: Answer keys for חלק ג' (דין מהותי) sittings whose פתרון PDF carries NO TEXT
LAYER — each page is a single scanned image — and so cannot be parsed.
TRANSCRIBED BY HAND: the pages were rendered with PyMuPDF and read, then the
answer-letter column was cropped and read a second time, independently. Both
extract-real-questions.mjs uses this in place of parse_key for any sitting
If a citation here ever disagrees with the PDF, the PDF wins: this file is a
transcription, not a source. The מהותי twin of keys-2022-transcribed.json on
